purpose: Source-indexed vowel/register/coda evidence register. Rows document cited examples; they are not an adjudicated gold corpus and must not be used as a universal deterministic grapheme-to-IPA table.

status_vocabulary.SOURCE_ATTESTED_NOT_GOLD: A source explicitly provides the form and/or transcription; not independently adjudicated against recordings or multiple lexical sources.
status_vocabulary.CONFLICTING_SOURCE_ANALYSES: Sources provide non-equivalent examples or transcription analyses; preserve alternatives and do not collapse into one universal rule.
status_vocabulary.NOT_ESTABLISHED: No deterministic IPA or Ukrainian output is justified by the current evidence.

unicode17-ch16.role: Authoritative encoding/orthographic reference with illustrative pronunciations; not an acoustic experiment

chem2020.role: Acoustic study of a small Phnom Penh speaker sample; supports contextual dimensions, not individual rows unless directly studied

cases.register_condition: first series; source's illustrative inherent-vowel example
cases.phonological_interpretation: R12A's representative inherent-vowel contrast for first-series ក.
limitations: Do not generalize to every coda, lexical environment, or dialect.
Unicode 17 Table 16-7 gives a different illustrative lexical item/transcription for ក; see KHV-008.

cases.register_condition: second series; source's illustrative inherent-vowel example
cases.phonological_interpretation: R12A's representative inherent-vowel contrast for second-series គ.
limitations: Do not generalize to every coda, lexical environment, or dialect.
Unicode 17 Table 16-7 gives a different illustrative lexical item/transcription for គ; see KHV-008.

cases.phonological_interpretation: R12A's example of a series-conditioned realization of the same dependent vowel sign.
limitations: One representative form; not a full sign-by-series matrix.

cases.phonological_interpretation: R12A's contrast with កី; demonstrates that the dependent sign does not have one invariant vowel value.
limitations: One representative form; not a full sign-by-series matrix.

cases.phonological_interpretation: R12A's example of dependent vowel ា after a first-series consonant.
limitations: Not sufficient to infer the value in closed syllables or other profiles.

cases.phonological_interpretation: R12A's contrast with កា; illustrates series-conditioned vowel interpretation.
limitations: Not sufficient to infer the value in closed syllables or other profiles.

cases.register_condition: NIKAHIT coda/nucleus context; Unicode 17 lexical illustration
cases.phonological_interpretation: Unicode 17 contrasts this NIKAHIT spelling with ដម; source gives the lexical gloss 'to pound'.
limitations: Encoding-standard illustration, not independent acoustic/lexical adjudication.
Do not generalize to all NIKAHIT spellings.

cases.orthography: ក / គ (Unicode 17 Table 16-7 illustrative lexical examples)
cases.register_condition: Unicode 17 Table 16-7; distinct lexical glosses and bracketed transcriptions
cases.phonological_interpretation: Unicode 17 gives ក ‘neck’ [kɔː] and គ ‘mute’ [kɔ̀ː], which are not interchangeable with R12A's simplified ក /kɑː/ vs គ /kɔː/ examples.

alternatives.forms: ក vs គ representative contrast

cases.selection_criterion: Retain both source-specific examples; do not promote either pair into a universal register-to-vowel mapping until lexical identity, transcription convention, dialect and context are reconciled.
limitations: The sources need not be describing the same lexical items or phonetic context.
A phonological class contrast is supported; a universal deterministic mapping is not.

cases.register_condition: plain coda vs COENG/subscript cluster; syllabification differs
cases.phonological_interpretation: Unicode 17's contrast illustrates that changing the orthographic/syllabic structure changes the vowel outcome; not a generic coda substitution rule.
limitations: The two transcriptions are retained as source-specific contrast examples, not an adjudicated dialect-normalized gold pair.

coverage_policy: Rows with ukrainian_adaptation=null are deliberate: the repository has a proposed segment adapter, but these word-level outputs have not been adjudicated and must not be presented as confident lexical transcriptions.
